attention.what: On a livestream after Ramaswamy criticized him at AmericaFest, said he would work against Ramaswamy's election and called it the only 2026 race he cares about.
After Ramaswamy won the GOP primary, urged followers on his livestream to vote for Democrat Amy Acton as a protest vote or stay home.
As Ohio early voting opened, posted repeated calls on X for followers to vote for Acton; one post drew about 2 million views.
Posted an unverified, unsourced claim about Amy Acton's conduct at an event; the Ohio Republican Party's account amplified it and credited her.
Said he would not vote for Republican Mike Rogers and praised Democrat Abdul El-Sayed's campaign, in a conversation with Saagar Enjeti.
In his newsletter, defended El-Sayed's 2021 remarks on post 9/11 U.S. military action after the Rogers campaign attacked them.
On War Room, warned that Ken Paxton has a real fight against James Talarico and told Republicans to assume they are losing.
On an episode with Ron White, praised Talarico on one issue, questioned some of his positions, and said he did not know enough about Paxton; no endorsement.
The comedian voiced support for Democrat James Talarico while a guest on The Joe Rogan Experience.
Gave $158 million to Senate Leadership Fund, which routed large sums to a pro Paxton Texas PAC, plus $10 million to Lone Star Liberty PAC.
Posted on X criticizing Talarico and helped spread a false claim about his campaign absence; Talarico said he had the flu.
Musk's super PAC disclosed its first spending for Paxton, about $250,000 on mailers, signs and flyers, with more Texas spending soon after.
Called Talarico honest on the Pivot podcast, then joined him onstage in Fort Worth, short of a formal endorsement.
Appeared in a video launching the Teachers for Talarico effort.
The band endorsed Talarico on Instagram.
Hosted a Los Angeles fundraiser for Talarico with his wife.
Gave $250,000 to Lone Star Rising, a super PAC backing Talarico, plus individual contributions.
Endorsed Democratic socialist Francesca Hong in the Democratic primary and appeared at her Milwaukee rally.
Endorsed and campaigned with El-Sayed; in September the El-Sayed campaign publicly disagreed with remarks Piker made in an Axios interview.
Group now led by Erika Kirk's organization runs a full time ballot chase field operation in New Hampshire's Senate race featuring Republican John E. Sununu.

notes: FUENTES AND OHIO: The attention was on the governor race, not the Senate race. Fuentes said in Dec 2025 that he would work against Ramaswamy. After the May 2026 primary he urged followers to vote for Democrat Amy Acton as a protest or stay home, and he renewed that with X posts on Oct 8 to 10, 2026, as early voting opened. Lean is set to other because he describes himself as on the right while urging a vote for the Democrat. In Dec 2025 Ramaswamy's campaign said it was focused on Ohioans, not fringe voices. As of May 2026, NBC4 reported that neither campaign had commented on his support for Acton. An OSU analyst told NBC4 the support is unlikely to be influential. Coverage describes his attacks on Ramaswamy as based on Ramaswamy's ethnicity and religion; no slurs are reproduced here. CONTEXT: Graham Platner won the Maine Democratic primary but withdrew in July 2026, and Troy Jackson is now the nominee. El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic primary on Aug 4. Michele Tafoya is the Minnesota GOP Senate nominee, and Trump did not endorse in that primary, per AP via ABC15. Trump endorsed Randy Feenstra for Iowa governor on May 29 and Burt Jones for Georgia governor, and both lost their primaries before he backed the winners. In Georgia, Newsweek dates the Rick Jackson endorsement to July 23, inferred from its publication date. Trump renewed his Mike Rogers endorsement on Aug 5, 2026; he had first endorsed him in 2025. Trump's Nevada endorsement of Lombardo is listed by Newsweek, but the only dated report found is from 2022. Karrin Taylor Robson, whom Trump had also endorsed in Arizona, withdrew, and Biggs won the July 21 primary. Obama also endorsed Juliana Stratton, IL Senate, on Oct 12 and Deb Haaland, NM governor, on Oct 8; neither race is on the competitive list. Sean O'Brien personally gave $1,000 to Scott Brown's NH Senate primary campaign in February 2026. SOURCING: No DDHQ, Politico, X, NYT or Star Tribune pages were used. A Hawaii Tribune Herald reprint of a NYT story on Carlson and a WRAL reprint of a NYT story on paid influencers were set aside. Several Hill, CNBC and MS NOW pages failed to load. The 200 search shared limit for this turn was reached before I could check Obama on Sherrod Brown, Roy Cooper, Pappas, Hobbs and Aaron Ford, or more AFL-CIO and national group endorsements, so those are incomplete.
